items.title: Hold an Albuquerque business license
items.authority: City of Albuquerque Department of Finance and Administrative Services
items.description: Businesses must register with the city for each location before operating. Since July 1, 2025 the city is moving from business registration to an annual business license; existing registrations need no action.

items.title: Renew Las Cruces business registration
items.authority: City of Las Cruces Business Registrations
items.description: Any business with a physical location in the city needs a registration before operating, after getting a New Mexico CRS tax ID; registrations last 12 months and the city mails a renewal notice about a month before expiration.

items.title: Renew Rio Rancho business registration
items.authority: City of Rio Rancho City Clerk
items.description: Businesses operating in Rio Rancho need a registration or license (commercial, home-based, out-of-city or limited-time), and every business must hold a New Mexico business tax ID.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Santa Fe
items.description: Use the cited official state business resource as a starting point, then confirm city and county licensing requirements before operating.
